s: Dine hanhagat challa beissat matztza ubo k"a seipim: hoil vetzarik letzamtzem beshiur kol issa veissa shello tehe gedola mishshiur challa, veim ken yesh lachosh shemma miqtzat haissot lo haya bahen shiur challa, lepikak tob lizzaher shello lehaprish min kol issa veissa bipne atzmah, shehare challa zo shehiprish mehaissot shello haya bahen shiur challa enah shava kelum, veim ken kesheyyopeh mehen matztzot yesh lachosh shemma yanniach harbeh matztzot mimmatztzot hallalu bikli echad, veaz yitchayyebu bechalla im yesh bahen shiur challa keshennitztorp[u] yachad, shehakkeli metzorpan leshiur challa, vehu lo yasim el libbo lehaprish challa mimmatztzot hallalu shebbetok hakkeli, sheyyismok al hachalla shehiprish mehaissot, venimtza okel tebel:

Ella ketzad yaaseh? Yaprish challa achat mikkol shette issot (o yoter) sheyyesh lehistappeq bahen shemma en shiur challa bekol achat veachat bipne atzmo, dehaynu sheyyiqqach shette issot (o yoter) veyadbeq qetzotam zo bazo ad sheyyihyu noshekot zo bazo, dehaynu sheyyihyu kol kak debuqot ad sheim yirtzeh lehapridan yittalesh meat issa mizzo veyidbaq bachabertah umeat issa mechabertah yidbaq bah, veal yede ken nechshabot keissa achat, umetzorpot leshiur challa, veyaprish meachad mehen challa achat veday bekak, kevan shehem nechshabot keissa achat:

Veim haissot hen qashot qetzat veenan nidbaqin heteb zo bazo — yanniach qetzeh haachat al qetzeh hashshenit veyachtok challa achat mishshete qetzot haissa yachad, veal yede dochaq hachittuk hen nidbaqin heteb zo bazo:

Veakshav shennahagu haolam lalush issot gedolot mishshiur challa mittaam shennitbaer besiman tn"v (ayyen sham sheen linhog ken) — hen maprishin challa mikkol issa veissa bipne atzmah. Venahagu shemmikkol issa veissa mapreshet ishsha acheret umebareket leatzmah. Abal im adam echad maprish mikkol haissot — day bibraka achat lekullan im eno nimlak (ayyen siman qs"t veqa"z ver"v), sheim bishat beraka haya bedato liptor bibraka zo kol hachallot sheyyaprish ap al pi shello haya yodea az kamma challot yaprish — en zeh nimlak, ella im ken hipsiq benetayim besicha sheen bah tzorek lehaprashat challa. Abal im hesiach bidbarim sheyyesh bahen tzorek lehaprashat challa sheyyaprish min haissot sheyyalush od, kegon shessach meinyene lishat haissot sheyyalush od — en sicha zo mapseqet (ayyen siman qs"z):

Yesh limchot bannashim shekkopelin baissa bishat haprashat challa kede lehaprish mishshete qetzoteha, veyesh lelammedan sheyyaprishu miqqatzeh echad, veechad yaarok bimgalgelet baqqatzeh hab', shello tehe haissa penuya meeseq apillu rega echad:

Veim hammitasseqin baissa mitasseqin bah bimhirut kol kak ad shei epshar lehaprish challa mehaissa beodan mitasseqin bah ad sheyyebattelu otam mimmehirutan — en tzarik lebattelan, ella yaprish challa leachar apiyya miyyad sheyyitten kol hammatztzot likli echad, vehakkeli metzorpan leshiur challa ap im lo haya bekol issa bipne atzmah kashshiur, umaprish chatika mimmatztza achat al kol hammatztzot shebbakkeli. Veap al pi shellekattechilla mitzva min hammubchar lehaprish challa min haissa velo min happat (perush beeretz yisrael min haddin, ubechutz laaretz mimmiddat chasidut) kemo sheyyitbaer, shenneemar "reshit arisotekem", beodah issa, mikkol maqom zeh shennimna lehaprish min haissa kede shello lebattel haoseqin bah mimmehirutan — hare zeh oseh gam ken mitzva min hammubchar. Venakon lekol adam laasot ken:

Bammeh debarim amurim shetztzarik tzerup keli? Keshemmaprish mimmatztzot hannaasot meissot sheyyesh lehistappeq bahen shemma lo haya shiur challa bekol issa bipne atzmah, venimtza shello nitchayyebu hammatztzot bechalla chiyyub barur ella im ken nitztarepu yachad, laken tzarik tzerup keli. Abal issa gedola sheyyesh bah shiur challa veshakach velo hiprish mimmenna beodah issa venizkar leachar sheapa mimmenna matztzot — en tzarik lehaprish mikkol matztza umatztza bipne atzmah, veken en tzarik letzarep hammatztzot bikli ulehaprish meachat al kullan, ella ap al pi shello nitztarepu yachad maprish meachat al kullan, shehare kebar nitztarepu venitchayyebu bechalla beodam issa:

Umikkol maqom, im hu beeretz yisrael tzarik sheyyihyu kol hammatztzot hallalu munnachot lepanayv semukot zo lazo beshaa shemmaprish meachat mehen al kullan, shechallat eretz yisrael enah nittelet ella min hammuqqap (perush min hassamuk), kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman shk"g. Abal en tzarik sheyyiggeu zeh bazeh bishat haprasha, ella kevan shehen semukot umeqorabot zo lazo — hare zeh min hammuqqap:

Abal bechutza laaretz en tzarik litrom min hammuqqap. Velo od, ella shemmuttar lo leekol kol hammatztzot hallalu qodem haprashat challa, raq sheyyeshayyer chatika meachat mehen veyaprish challa mechatika zo al kol hammatztzot sheakal, sheheqellu chakamim bechallat chutza laaretz lihyot okel veholek veachar kak maprish, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea sham:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshekkol matztzot hallalu hen meissa achat, shekkebar hayu muqqapot umechubbarot zo lazo paam achat beodam issa, lekak heqellu bahen chakamim sheen tzarik lachazor ulehaqqipam bishat haprashat challa im hi challat chutza laaretz. Abal matztzot habbaot mib' issot shehaya bahen shiur challa bekol achat bipne atzmah, im rotzeh lehaprish matztza achat al kullan — tzarik sheyyihyu hammatztzot shel issa hashshenit muqqapot im matztza zo beshaa shemmaprish mimmenna alehen, dekevan shello hayu muqqapot umechubbarot zo im zo meolam — lo heqellu chakamim bahen lehaprish meachat al chabertah shello min hammuqqap apillu bechutza laaretz. Abal keshemmaqqipan zo lazo — day bekak, veen tzarik letzorpam bikli, kevan shekkebar nitchayyebu bechalla beodam issa. Abal matztzot habbaot meissot shello haya bahen shiur challa bekol achat bipne atzmah venatan hammatztzot betok keli echad letzorpam leshiur challa — en tzarik lehaprish mehen beodan mitztorpin bakkeli, ella yakol leekol mehen veachar kak yaprish mechatikat matztza achat gam al mah sheakal kebar, dekevan shennitztarepu hammatztzot lechalla bikli echad — (she)hare naasu kematztza achat gedola sheyyesh bah shiur challa, shemmuttar leekol mimmenna qodem haprashat challa. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veoserin leekol mimmatztzot hallalu qodem haprashat challa, lepi shetztzarik litrom mehen min hammuqqap kevan shello hayu mechubbarot zo bazo beodan issa, veap shelleachar ken nitztarepu bikli echad — en tzerup zeh moil lechabberan sheyyihyu nechshabin kematztza achat mammash:

Ulepi sebara zo, im shakach lehaprish challa mimmatztzot hallalu qodem yom tob venizkar beyom tob, vei epshar lehaprish challa beyom tob kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"v — lo day bemah sheyyeshayyer matztza achat lehaprish challa mimmenna leachar yom tob gam al matztzot sheakal beyom tob, ella tzarik hu leshayyer meat mikkol matztza kede litrom min hammuqqap, o yaaseh kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"v. Abal lepi sebara harishona, day sheyyeshayyer meat mimmatztza achat im kebar nitztarepu matztzot hallalu bikli echad qodem yom tob. Abal im nitztarepu beyom tob — en tzarik leshayyer mehem kelum, ella yakol lehaprish mehen challa beyom tob, shello aseru lehaprish challa beyom tob ella meissa shennillosha venitchayyeba bechalla meereb yom tob shehaya epshar lo lehaprishah mibbeod yom, abal matztzot hallalu shehayu peturot beereb yom tob venitchayyebu beyom tob al yede tzerup keli — muttar lehaprish mehen beyom tob, kederek shemmuttar lehaprish meissa shennillosha beyom tob. Uleinyan pesaq halaka — haiqqar kassebara harishona, veap al pi ken tob lachosh lekattechilla lassebara haacharona litrom mimmatztzot hallalu min hammuqqap ap shehayu metzorapin kebar bikli. Vetob lehachamir sheap shemmaprish mehen beodan metzorapin bikli — yizzaher sheyyiggeu zeh bazeh, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheen niqra min hammuqqap ella keshennogein zeh bazeh, veyesh omerim sheeno niqra min hammuqqap ella im ken hem betok keli echad ap al pi sheenan nogein zeh bazeh, vire shamayim yotze yede shenehem:

Veen tzarik lomar im matztzot hallalu baot mishshete issot shehaya shiur challa bekol achat bipne atzmah shehen tzerikin haqqapa meiqqar haddin beshaa shemmaprish meachat al chabertah, shettob lehachamir sheyyiggeu zeh bazeh bishat haprasha. Vaapillu matztzot habbaot meissa achat shehaya bah shiur challa shelledibre hakkol en tzarik lehaprish mehen min hammuqqap bechutza laaretz apillu lekattechilla, shehare ameru challat chutza laaretz okel veholek veachar kak maprish — ap al pi ken middat chasidut hu lehachamir lehaprish mehen min hammuqqap sheyyiggeu zo bazo betok hakkeli bishat haprasha. Ulepikak en leekol mehen qodem haprasha, shehare mah sheyyokal lo yihyeh muqqap im mah sheyyaprish, veken nohagin. Ayyen siman r"s:

Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad sheabar vehiprish shello min hammuqqap, apillu b' issot sheyyesh bekol achat bipne atzmah shiur challa veenan semukot zo lazo ella zo munnachat bebayit zeh vezo munnachat bebayit acher vehiprish challa meachat mehen vehaya bedato liptor bechalla zo gam et hashsheniyya — hare zeh petura, veen tzarik lachazor ulehaprish gam mimmenna, shello hitzriku chakamim litrom min hammuqqap ella lekattechilla:

Abal b' issot sheen bahen shiur challa bekol achat bipne atzmah veabar vehiprish mehen challa belo tzerup keli, apillu hayu shettehen semukot zo lazo, vaapillu hayu nogeot zo bazo, im lo hayu noshekot zo bazo — enan mitztorpot. Ulepikak en challa zo shava kelum, kevan shehiprishah beshaa shehayu peturot:

Mi sheshshakach velo hiprish challa meissa shel matztzat mitzva shehaya bah shiur challa bipne atzmah o al yede tzerup im issa acheret shel matztzat mitzva venizkar leachar sheapa mimmennu g' matztzot hatztzerikot lo leseder lel shel pesach — lo yaprish meotan matztzot shetztzarik lihyot shelemot al haqqeara, dehaynu matztza elyona vetachtona, shehaelyona tzerika lihyot shelema lebarek aleha "hammotzi", vehattachtona tzerika lihyot shelema laasot mimmenna kerikot im hammaror, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"h, ella yaprish meotah matztza sheen tzerika lihyot shelema, dehaynu matztza haemtzait hamzummenet libtzoa mimmenna chatika laapiqoman qodem amirat hahaggada:

Mi shehayu lo issot harbeh shehaya bahen shiur challa bekol achat bipne atzmah, vehiprish challa mimmiqtzat haissot umimmiqtzatan lo hiprish, veapa kol haissot beyachad venitarebu matztzot hachayyabot adayin bechalla im matztzot shennipteru kebar bechiyyuban — eno yakol lehaprish mimmatztza achat al kullan apillu im yaknis kullan letok keli echad veyiggeu zeh bazeh, lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma matztza zo shehu maprish mimmenna hi mimmatztzot shennipteru mechiyyuban, veen maprishin min happetur al hachiyyub. Lepikak, tzarik hu lehaprish mikkol matztza umatztza bipne atzmah, o yalush od issa qetanna veyopeh otah vitzorpah bikli echad im kol hammatztzot hallalu, veal yede ken nitchayyeba bechalla ap al pi sheen bah kashshiur, veyaprish mimmenna al hammatztzot hachayyabot adayin. Abal qodem sheyyopeh otah — en letzarep otah im hammatztzot bikli echad kede lehaprish mimmenna alehen, shehare hatztzerup oseh otan keillu hen dabar echad vachatika achat mammash, vekevan shehi issa vehen matztzot apuyot — ek epshar sheyyitztarepu veyihyu kachatika achat mammash? Abal im yesh beissa zo shiur challa bipne atzmah belo tzerup keli — en tzarik leepotah qodem haprashat challa, veen tzarik letzorpah bikli im hammatztzot meiqqar haddin, ella yaqqipem yachad veyaprish meissa zo gam al hammatztzot hachayyabot adayin. Veim hu makkir matztza achat bitbiut ayin veyodea bah shehi mimmatztzot hachayyabot — en tzarik lekol zeh, ella maprish mimmatztza zo al kol shear matztzot hachayyabot ap sheenan muqqapot meiqqar haddin:

Ap al pi sheasur laadam lalush issato pachot mikkashshiur kede lepotrah min hachalla, mikkol maqom beyom tob shel pesach hittiru laasot ken (ayyen besop siman tn"v ek linhog bazeh), sheim yalush kashshiur veyaprish mimmenna challa — en lechalla zo taqqana bizman hazzeh sheen maakilin otah lakkohanim kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman shk"b, veim ken asur leepotah beyom tob, kevan sheen baapiyya zo tzorek okel nepesh, ulesorpah gam ken eno yakol, sheen sorepin qadashim beyom tob kemo shennitbaer besiman tq"v, veim yannichenna kak keshehi issa ad motzae yom tob veaz yisrepenna — yesh lachosh shemma tachmitz veyaabor aleha be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", veap shenneemar "lo yeraeh leka", shelleka i atta roeh — abal atta roeh shel gaboah, mikkol maqom challa zo enah niqret shel gaboah ella shello, hoil veyesh lo bah tzad hetter, sheim yitcharet al mah shehiprish otah lechalla yishal lechakam veyattir lo vetachazor challa zo lihyot chullin kema shehayeta veyachazor veyaprish challa acheret:

Veim era shellash shiur challa — lo yaprish challa min haissa, ella yopeh mimmenna matztzot veyaprish mimmatztza achat al kullan. Veim eno rotzeh libtzoa hammatztza ella rotzeh leepot uga qetanna lehaprish otah lechalla achar apiyyatah — tzarik hu lizzaher qodem apiyyatah shello yiqra lah shem challa ella yiqraenna uga o matztza (vegam lo yihyeh bedato shettachul aleha qedushshat challa ad leachar apiyyatah), sheim qodem apiyyatah (haya bedato shezzo hi challa min haissa, veen tzarik lomar im) qara lah shem challa bepiv — hare kebar nitqaddesha lechalla, shehare kol qedushshat terumot umaasrot hen al yede dibbur (o apillu al yede machashaba bilbad), veim ken asur lo leepotah beyom tob. Abal kol zeman shello nitqaddesha lechalla, ap al pi sheyyesh bedato bishat apiyya sheyyiqra lah shem challa leachar apiyyatah, mikkol maqom kevan shebbishat apiyyatah en bedato sheyyehe aleha qedushshat challa, veim haya rotzeh haya yakol lehaprish matztza acheret lechalla veleekol uga zo — nimtza sheyyesh lo bah tzad hetter akila bishat apiyyatah, lepikak hittiru lo leepotah beyom tob ap sheen kan hetter gamur, shehare bishat apiyyat uga zo yodea hu shessopo shello leekol mimmenna beyom tob, ap al pi ken hittiru lo chakamim kevan shei epshar beinyan acher sheyyihyeh bo hetter gamur. (Sheap sheepshar lo shello lehaprish uga shelema lechalla ella yaprish chatika mimmatztza achat umah sheyyishshaer meotah matztza yokal beyom tob, venimtza sheapiyyat otah hammatztza haya bah gam tzorek okel nepesh velo bishbil hachalla bilbad, mikkol maqom gam im yaaseh ken en kan hetter gamur im haya epshar beinyan acher, shehare ameru chakamim: issa chetzyah shel yisrael vechetzyah shel nokri asur leyisrael leepotah kullah beyom tob, ap sheoseh mimmenna kikkar echad veopeo bebat achat venimtza sheyyesh baapiyya zo gam tzorek akilat yisrael, ap al pi ken aseru chakamim, hoil shebbaapiyyat chetzyah shel nokri en bah tzorek laakilat hayyisrael, shehare yakol lechalleq im hannokri qodem haapiyya veleepot chelqo bilbaddo, ap kan hoil shebbaapiyyat chatikat hachalla shebbeotah matztza en bah tzorek laapiyyat hashshear shel otah matztza, shehare ap im haya maprish hachalla meotah matztza qodem apiyyatah hayeta otah matztza neepet yapeh kol kak kemo shenneepet akshav im hachalla, lepikak haya rauy leesor leepotah beyom tob, ella shehittiru chakamim kevan shei epshar beinyan acher). Veim shakach o abar vehiprish challa meissa zo veqara lah shem challa — lo yopeh challa zo velo yisrepenna, ella yetilenna lemayim tzonenim bishbil shello tachmitz, shehatztzonenim meakkebim otah shello tachmitz, ulemotzae yom tob yisrepenna. Ukesheroeh shehammayim mitchammemim qetzat beomdam babbayit — yizzaher lehachalipam bemayim acherim tzonenim, dehaynu sheyyishab mayim hallalu min hakkeli shehachalla munnachat sham veyishpok lesham mayim acherim tzonenim, abal lo yetaltel hakkeli shehachalla munnachat bo kede lishpok mayim hallalu mittokah, shekkeli zeh naasa basis ledabar haasur betiltul, dehaynu hachalla shehi asura betiltul leachar sheqqara lah shem kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"v (ayyen sham kol perate din zeh). Abal lekattechilla lo yiqra lah shem lachalla beodah issa ulehatilah lemayim tzonenin, gezera shemma lo yizzaher yapeh sheyyihyu hammayim tzonenin:

Vekol zeh keshebbaal habbayit beatzmo qara lah shem challa (o shear kol adam sheyyesh lo reshut mimmennu lehaprish challa meissato, shehare hu kishlucho, veal derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman shk"ch). Abal im adam sheen lo reshut mimmennu lehaprish challa meissato qara lah shem challa — enah challa kelal, umuttar leepotah beyom tob:

Vekol zeh bechallat eretz yisrael sheenah neekelet lakkohanim bizman hazzeh, shekkullanu temee metim venitmet hachalla, vaasura lehaakil apillu lekohen tahor, ulepikak asur leepotah beyom tob. Abal challat chutza laaretz sheenah asura ella al mi shettuma yotzea alayv miggupo, kegon zab o baal qeri, ben leonso ben lirtzono, abal kohen hattahor mizzab umiqqeri, kegon kohen qatan pachot mibben t' shanim veyom echad sheeno metamme beqeri, vegam min hassetam lo raa ziba kevan shehu pachot mibben t' (abal im yadua sheraa ziba apillu hu ben yom echad tame), veken kohen gadol sheraa qeri ella shettabal leqiryo bem' sea bemayim kesherim, al derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman r"a, ap al pi shello heerib shimsho — rashshay hu leekol challat chutza laaretz. Ap al pi shehu tame mittumat met ushear tumot, vegam hachalla temea hi, ap al pi ken heqellu chakamim bechallat chutza laaretz, sheenah ella lehekker ulezikkaron shello tishtakkach torat challa, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman shk"b, lepikak im qara lah shem beyom tob shel pesach — rashshay leepotah im yesh kohen qatan o gadol shettabal sheyyokal mimmenna beyom tob. Vetob lizzaher sheyyokal miyyad achar tebilato, velo yatil mayim ben tebila laakila, shemma yatil mayim chaluqim o akurim sheyyesh bahen chashash qeri, vihe asur leekol challa zo ad sheyyachazor veyitbol. Vekol kohen shehu yoter mibben t' shanim, ap al pi shehu omer shello raa qeri — en maakilin lo hachalla ella im ken tabal, dekevan shebben t' biato bia — hare hu bachazaqa sheraa qeri:

Veim en sham ella kohen gadol shello tabal leqiryo — yakol leepotah al yede sheyyebattelenna berob qodem haapiyya, dekevan shennitbattel berob — mutteret apillu lekohen tame, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman shk"g. (Vekol zeh keshekkebar qara lah shem challa, abal lekattechilla en liqrot lah shem challa beodah issa apillu yesh sham kohen tahor, shekkebar nahagu bimdinot ellu shello lehaakil challa lakkohen, mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman shk"b ayyen sham):
